Class PooledObjectHandle<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Pool
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Handle for a pooled object returned by ObjectPool<T>. Disposing this handle returns the underlying instance to the pool.

public sealed class PooledObjectHandle<T> : IDisposable where T : class

The reference type stored in the pool.

Methods

Dispose()

Disposes the handle, returning the contained instance to its owning pool.

public void Dispose()

Remarks

This method is idempotent and thread-safe: it atomically clears the internal pool reference so that only the first caller actually returns the instance. After disposal, accessing Value throws ObjectDisposedException.
